newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey and Romania sign free trade agreement.
newsitem.headline: Turkey and Romania sign free trade agreement.

text.p: Turkey and Romania signed a free trade agreement on Tuesday and pledged each other support in their joint goal of further integration with Europe, Anatolian news agency said.
Turkish President Suleyman Demirel said the goal of both countries was further integration with Europe and that NATO-member Turkey fully supported Romania's candidacy for the alliance.
Romanian President Emil Constantinescu visiting Turkey to attend a conference of Black Sea nations, said that the volume of trade between the two countries would soon pass the $1 billion mark.
Romania is lobbying for inclusion in NATO's first eastward expansion to be announced at a summit in Madrid in July. But Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic are seen as more certain candidates.
